This clarification applies to comm_sound + qty_minus and comm_sound + rel_down. In these forms, comm_sound covers human communication (oral, written and social-media messages), and sound produced by people directly or through technical means: voice, rustling, playing music, a car. Natural sounds such as rain and animal sounds are outside this definition. Context determines the reading: «говори поменьше», «можно потише», «сделайте потише», «пиши меньше». Less noise, please. is one such reading. In these specified uses, qty_minus and rel_down are synonymous. The two comm_speak variants retain their existing meanings; no general LESS/DOWN equivalence is introduced.
